title: A new OpenSpec project silently has no OpenSpec skills
what: relay setup installs the flow plugins it enables (claude plugin install sdd@relay --scope project) or says plainly what to run; relay doctor <project> checks that the plugins the project enables are installed.
why: relay setup --flow openspec switches sdd@relay on in the project settings but nothing installs it, so the owner opens the new project and the plan, spec-review, apply and archive skills are missing with no message.
failing_case: Trial 2026-10-23: on this Mac only sdd@principles was installed (no sdd@relay in the installed plugins); relay setup <folder> --flow openspec ended with Done and no warning, and a session in the folder had no sdd skills until claude plugin install sdd@relay --scope project was run. relay doctor <folder> checks only the user-level core/observe/delegate/front plugins.
pass_cases: After setup --flow openspec the project has sdd@relay installed; if the install cannot run, the todo list names the exact command; doctor <project> reports FIX when an enabled plugin is not installed.
